name: H.M. Electro Mech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2003, H.M. Electro Mech Limited is an infrastructure firm specializing in turnkey projects, commissioning of pumping machinery, and providing comprehensive operation and maintenance services.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview[1]
H.M. Electro Mech Limited (HMEL) specializes in turnkey projects, including supply, installation, testing, and commissioning (SITC) of pumping machinery. It offers comprehensive O&M services and handles infrastructure projects such as water supply schemes and railway electrification. 
HMEL also undertakes EPC projects involving pipelines, water treatment plants, pump house construction, and PLC-SCADA systems, along with selling pumps, pipes, transformers, motors, and accessories.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.16 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 34.3% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 75.4 days to 112 days
